scenes.heading: Roles & Template Folders (Part 1 of 2)
scenes.narration: Templates. Roles & Template Folders (Part 1 of 2). In this video we review 5 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What three roles collaborate to create a new template using the Templates Console and Template Editor?
scenes.heading: Admin, Developer, and Template Author
scenes.body: Building a template is a three-role collaboration: Admin, Developer, and Template Author. By working together, they create a template that meets the needs of the organization.

scenes.question: What is the Admin role responsible for when creating a new template?
scenes.heading: Creating a new folder for templates, which requires admin rights (though a developer can often also do it)
scenes.body: The Admin is responsible for creating a new folder for templates. This requires admin rights, but it can often also be done by a developer.

scenes.question: What is the Developer role responsible for when creating a new template?
scenes.heading: The technical/internal details — creating template files and configuring template settings
scenes.body: The Developer is responsible for the technical/internal details of the template, including creating the template files and configuring template settings, and needs experience with the development environment.

scenes.question: What is the Template Author role responsible for when creating a new template?
scenes.heading: Configuring the use of components and other high-level details of the template
scenes.body: The Template Author is responsible for configuring the use of components and other high-level details of the template, requiring some technical knowledge such as using patterns when defining paths, gathered from the developer.

scenes.question: What must happen before a template author can create a template in a given folder?
scenes.heading: An administrator must configure a template folder in the Configuration Browser and apply proper permissions first
scenes.body: An administrator must configure a template folder in the Configurations Browser and apply proper permissions before a template author can create a template in that folder.
